source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "social media" AND ("political communication" OR elections OR "election campaign" OR populism)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"social media" AND ("political communication" OR elections OR "election campaign" OR populism),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("social media" AND ("election campaign" OR "political communication" OR "elections" OR "populism"))
